verses.original: הָעָ֔ם וַיַּ֣רְא כִּֽי־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה בֹשֵׁ֥שׁ לָרֶ֣דֶת מִן־ הָהָ֑ר הָעָ֜ם וַיִּקָּהֵ֨ל עַֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֗ן וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ אֵלָיו֙ ק֣וּם׀ עֲשֵׂה־ לָ֣נוּ אֱלֹהִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר יֵֽלְכוּ֙ לְפָנֵ֔ינוּ כִּי־ זֶ֣ה׀ מֹשֶׁ֣ה הָאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֶֽעֱלָ֙נוּ֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לֹ֥א יָדַ֖עְנוּ מֶה־ הָ֥יָה לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·‘ām way·yar kî- mō·šeh ḇō·šêš lā·re·ḏeṯ min- hā·hār hā·‘ām way·yiq·qā·hêl ‘al- ’a·hă·rōn way·yō·mə·rū ’ê·lāw qūm ‘ă·śêh- lā·nū ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·šer yê·lə·ḵū lə·p̄ā·nê·nū kî- zeh mō·šeh hā·’îš ’ă·šer he·‘ĕ·lā·nū mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim lō yā·ḏa‘·nū meh- hā·yāh lōw
verses.literal: Now when the people saw that Moses was delayed in coming down from the mountain they gathered around Aaron and said - Come make us gods who will go before us As for this Moses - who brought us up out of the land of Egypt we do not know what has happened to him

verses.original: אַהֲרֹ֔ן וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵהֶם֙ פָּֽרְקוּ֙ הַזָּהָ֔ב נִזְמֵ֣י אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּאָזְנֵ֣י נְשֵׁיכֶ֔ם בְּנֵיכֶ֖ם וּבְנֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וְהָבִ֖יאוּ אֵלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’a·hă·rōn way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem pā·rə·qū haz·zā·hāḇ niz·mê ’ă·šer bə·’ā·zə·nê nə·šê·ḵem bə·nê·ḵem ū·ḇə·nō·ṯê·ḵem wə·hā·ḇî·’ū ’ê·lāy
verses.literal: So Aaron told them Take off the gold earrings that are on your wives and sons and daughters and bring them to me

verses.original: כָּל־ הָעָ֔ם אֶת־ וַיִּתְפָּֽרְקוּ֙ הַזָּהָ֖ב נִזְמֵ֥י אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּאָזְנֵיהֶ֑ם וַיָּבִ֖יאוּ אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹֽן׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- hā·‘ām ’eṯ- way·yiṯ·pā·rə·qū haz·zā·hāḇ niz·mê ’ă·šer bə·’ā·zə·nê·hem way·yā·ḇî·’ū ’el- ’a·hă·rōn
verses.literal: Then all the people - took off their gold earrings - - and brought them to Aaron

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח מִיָּדָ֗ם וַיָּ֤צַר בַּחֶ֔רֶט וַֽיַּעֲשֵׂ֖הוּ אֹתוֹ֙ מַסֵּכָ֑ה עֵ֣גֶל וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ אֵ֤לֶּה יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶעֱל֖וּךָ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ mî·yā·ḏām way·yā·ṣar ba·ḥe·reṭ way·ya·‘ă·śê·hū ’ō·ṯōw mas·sê·ḵāh ‘ê·ḡel way·yō·mə·rū ’êl·leh yiś·rā·’êl ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’ă·šer he·‘ĕ·lū·ḵā mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: He took [the gold] from their hands and with an engraving tool he fashioned it into a molten calf And they said These O Israel are your gods who brought you up out of the land of Egypt

verses.original: אַהֲרֹ֔ן וַיַּ֣רְא וַיִּ֥בֶן מִזְבֵּ֖חַ לְפָנָ֑יו וַיִּקְרָ֤א אַֽהֲרֹן֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר מָחָֽר׃ חַ֥ג לַיהוָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: ’a·hă·rōn way·yar way·yi·ḇen miz·bê·aḥ lə·p̄ā·nāw way·yiq·rā ’a·hă·rōn way·yō·mar mā·ḥār ḥaḡ Yah·weh
verses.literal: When Aaron saw this he built an altar before [the calf] and proclaimed . . . . . . Tomorrow [shall be] a feast to the LORD

verses.original: מִֽמָּחֳרָ֔ת וַיַּשְׁכִּ֙ימוּ֙ וַיַּעֲל֣וּ עֹלֹ֔ת וַיַּגִּ֖שׁוּ שְׁלָמִ֑ים הָעָם֙ וַיֵּ֤שֶׁב לֶֽאֱכֹ֣ל וְשָׁת֔וֹ וַיָּקֻ֖מוּ לְצַחֵֽק׃פ
verses.transliteration: mim·mā·ḥo·rāṯ way·yaš·kî·mū way·ya·‘ă·lū ‘ō·lōṯ way·yag·gi·šū šə·lā·mîm hā·‘ām way·yê·šeḇ le·’ĕ·ḵōl wə·šā·ṯōw way·yā·qu·mū lə·ṣa·ḥêq
verses.literal: So the next day they arose offered burnt offerings and presented peace offerings And the people sat down to eat and drink and got up to indulge in revelry

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה לֶךְ־ רֵ֕ד כִּ֚י עַמְּךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶעֱלֵ֖יתָ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃ שִׁחֵ֣ת
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh leḵ- rêḏ kî ‘am·mə·ḵā ’ă·šer he·‘ĕ·lê·ṯā mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim ši·ḥêṯ
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses Go down at once . . . for your people whom you brought up out of the land of Egypt have corrupted themselves

verses.original: מַהֵ֗ר סָ֣רוּ מִן־ הַדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתִ֔ם עָשׂ֣וּ לָהֶ֔ם מַסֵּכָ֑ה עֵ֖גֶל וַיִּשְׁתַּֽחֲווּ־ לוֹ֙ וַיִּזְבְּחוּ־ ל֔וֹ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ אֵ֤לֶּה יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶֽעֱל֖וּךָ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ma·hêr sā·rū min- had·de·reḵ ’ă·šer ṣiw·wî·ṯim ‘ā·śū lā·hem mas·sê·ḵāh ‘ê·ḡel way·yiš·ta·ḥă·wū- lōw way·yiz·bə·ḥū- lōw way·yō·mə·rū ’êl·leh yiś·rā·’êl ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’ă·šer he·‘ĕ·lū·ḵā mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: How quickly they have turned aside from the way that I commanded them They have made for themselves a molten calf and have bowed down to it They have sacrificed to it and said These O Israel are your gods who brought you up out of the land of Egypt

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה רָאִ֙יתִי֙ אֶת־ הַזֶּ֔ה הָעָ֣ם הֽוּא׃ וְהִנֵּ֥ה קְשֵׁה־ עֹ֖רֶף עַם־
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’el- mō·šeh rā·’î·ṯî ’eṯ- haz·zeh hā·‘ām hū wə·hin·nêh qə·šêh- ‘ō·rep̄ ‘am-
verses.literal: The LORD also said to Moses I have seen - this people and they are indeed a stiff-necked . . . people

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ לִּ֔י הַנִּ֣יחָה אַפִּ֥י וְיִֽחַר־ בָהֶ֖ם וַאֲכַלֵּ֑ם וְאֶֽעֱשֶׂ֥ה אוֹתְךָ֖ גָּדֽוֹל׃ לְג֥וֹי
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh lî han·nî·ḥāh ’ap·pî wə·yi·ḥar- ḇā·hem wa·’ă·ḵal·lêm wə·’e·‘ĕ·śeh ’ō·wṯ·ḵā gā·ḏō·wl lə·ḡō·w
verses.literal: Now leave Me alone so that My anger may burn against them and consume them Then I will make you into a great nation

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶת־ וַיְחַ֣ל פְּנֵ֖י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יו וַיֹּ֗אמֶר יְהוָה֙ לָמָ֤ה אַפְּךָ֙ יֶחֱרֶ֤ה בְּעַמֶּ֔ךָ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הוֹצֵ֙אתָ֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם גָּד֖וֹל בְּכֹ֥חַ חֲזָקָֽה׃ וּבְיָ֥ד
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh ’eṯ- way·ḥal pə·nê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāw way·yō·mer Yah·weh lā·māh ’ap·pə·ḵā ye·ḥĕ·reh bə·‘am·me·ḵā ’ă·šer hō·w·ṣê·ṯā mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim gā·ḏō·wl bə·ḵō·aḥ ḥă·zā·qāh ū·ḇə·yāḏ
verses.literal: But Moses - sought the favor . . . of the LORD his God saying O LORD why does Your anger burn against Your people whom You brought out of the land of Egypt with great power and a mighty hand

verses.original: לָמָּה֩ יֹאמְר֨וּ מִצְרַ֜יִם לֵאמֹ֗ר הֽוֹצִיאָם֙ בְּרָעָ֤ה לַהֲרֹ֤ג אֹתָם֙ בֶּֽהָרִ֔ים וּ֨לְכַלֹּתָ֔ם מֵעַ֖ל פְּנֵ֣י הָֽאֲדָמָ֑ה שׁ֚וּב מֵחֲר֣וֹן אַפֶּ֔ךָ וְהִנָּחֵ֥ם עַל־ הָרָעָ֖ה לְעַמֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: lām·māh yō·mə·rū miṣ·ra·yim lê·mōr hō·w·ṣî·’ām bə·rā·‘āh la·hă·rōḡ ’ō·ṯām be·hā·rîm ū·lə·ḵal·lō·ṯām mê·‘al pə·nê hā·’ă·ḏā·māh šûb̲ mê·ḥă·rō·wn ’ap·pe·ḵā wə·hin·nā·ḥêm ‘al- hā·rā·‘āh lə·‘am·me·ḵā
verses.literal: Why should the Egyptians declare . . . . . . He brought them out with evil intent to kill them in the mountains and wipe them from the face of the earth Turn from Your fierce anger and relent from {doing} harm to Your people

verses.original: זְכֹ֡ר עֲבָדֶ֗יךָ לְאַבְרָהָם֩ לְיִצְחָ֨ק וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל לָהֶם֮ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֣עְתָּ בָּךְ֒ וַתְּדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם זַרְעֲכֶ֔ם אַרְבֶּה֙ אֶֽת־ כְּכוֹכְבֵ֖י הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם אֶתֵּן֙ לְזַרְעֲכֶ֔ם וְכָל־ הַזֹּ֜את הָאָ֨רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֗רְתִּי וְנָחֲל֖וּ לְעֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: zə·ḵōr ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā lə·’aḇ·rā·hām lə·yiṣ·ḥāq ū·lə·yiś·rā·’êl lā·hem ’ă·šer niš·ba‘·tā bāḵ wat·tə·ḏab·bêr ’ă·lê·hem zar·‘ă·ḵem ’ar·beh ’eṯ- kə·ḵō·wḵ·ḇê haš·šā·mā·yim ’et·tên lə·zar·‘ă·ḵem wə·ḵāl haz·zōṯ hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer ’ā·mar·tî wə·nā·ḥă·lū lə·‘ō·lām
verses.literal: Remember Your servants Abraham Isaac and Israel to whom You swore by Your very self when You declared . . . {I will make} your descendants as numerous - as the stars in the sky and I will give your descendants all this land that I have promised and it shall be their inheritance forever

verses.original: יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּנָּ֖חֶם עַל־ הָ֣רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֖ר לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת לְעַמּֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yin·nā·ḥem ‘al- hā·rā·‘āh ’ă·šer dib·ber la·‘ă·śō·wṯ lə·‘am·mōw
verses.literal: So the LORD relented from the calamity - He had threatened to bring on His people

verses.original: מֹשֶׁה֙ וַיִּ֜פֶן וַיֵּ֤רֶד מִן־ הָהָ֔ר וּשְׁנֵ֛י לֻחֹ֥ת הָעֵדֻ֖ת בְּיָד֑וֹ לֻחֹ֗ת כְּתֻבִים֙ מִשְּׁנֵ֣י עֶבְרֵיהֶ֔ם הֵ֥ם כְּתֻבִֽים׃ מִזֶּ֥ה וּמִזֶּ֖ה
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh way·yi·p̄en way·yê·reḏ min- hā·hār ū·šə·nê lu·ḥōṯ hā·‘ê·ḏuṯ bə·yā·ḏōw lu·ḥōṯ kə·ṯu·ḇîm miš·šə·nê ‘eḇ·rê·hem hêm kə·ṯu·ḇîm miz·zeh ū·miz·zeh
verses.literal: Then Moses turned and went down the mountain with the two tablets of the Testimony in his hands . . . They were inscribed on both sides - front and back

verses.original: וְהַ֨לֻּחֹ֔ת מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים הֵ֑מָּה וְהַמִּכְתָּ֗ב מִכְתַּ֤ב אֱלֹהִים֙ ה֔וּא חָר֖וּת עַל־ הַלֻּחֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hal·lu·ḥōṯ ma·‘ă·śêh ’ĕ·lō·hîm hêm·māh wə·ham·miḵ·tāḇ miḵ·taḇ ’ĕ·lō·hîm hū ḥā·rūṯ ‘al- hal·lu·ḥōṯ
verses.literal: The tablets were the work of God . . . and the writing [was] the writing of God . . . engraved on the tablets

verses.original: יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ אֶת־ וַיִּשְׁמַ֧ע ק֥וֹל הָעָ֖ם בְּרֵעֹ֑ה וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה ק֥וֹל מִלְחָמָ֖ה בַּֽמַּחֲנֶה׃
verses.transliteration: yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ’eṯ- way·yiš·ma‘ qō·wl hā·‘ām bə·rē·ʿōh way·yō·mer ’el- mō·šeh qō·wl mil·ḥā·māh bam·ma·ḥă·nɛh
verses.literal: When Joshua - heard the sound of the people shouting he said to Moses The sound of war [is] in the camp

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אֵ֥ין קוֹל֙ עֲנ֣וֹת גְּבוּרָ֔ה וְאֵ֥ין ק֖וֹל עֲנ֣וֹת חֲלוּשָׁ֑ה אָנֹכִ֖י שֹׁמֵֽעַ׃ ק֣וֹל עַנּ֔וֹת
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ên qō·wl ‘ă·nō·wṯ gə·ḇū·rāh wə·’ên qō·wl ‘ă·nō·wṯ ḥă·lū·šāh ’ā·nō·ḵî šō·mê·a‘ qō·wl ‘an·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: But Moses replied It is neither the cry . . . of victory nor the cry . . . of defeat I hear the sound of singing

verses.original: וַֽיְהִ֗י כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר קָרַב֙ אֶל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וַיַּ֥רְא אֶת־ הָעֵ֖גֶל וּמְחֹלֹ֑ת מֹשֶׁ֗ה וַיִּֽחַר־ אַ֣ף וַיַּשְׁלֵ֤ךְ הַלֻּחֹ֔ת מִיָּדוֹ אֶת־ וַיְשַׁבֵּ֥ר אֹתָ֖ם תַּ֥חַת הָהָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ka·’ă·šer qā·raḇ ’el- ham·ma·ḥă·neh way·yar ’eṯ- hā·‘ê·ḡel ū·mə·ḥō·lōṯ mō·šeh way·yi·ḥar- ’ap̄ way·yaš·lêḵ hal·lu·ḥōṯ mī·yå̄·ḏō ’eṯ- way·šab·bêr ’ō·ṯām ta·ḥaṯ hā·hār
verses.literal: - As [Moses] approached . . . the camp and saw - the calf and the dancing he burned with anger and threw the tablets out of his hands - shattering them at the base of the mountain

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֞ח אֶת־ הָעֵ֨גֶל אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשׂוּ֙ וַיִּשְׂרֹ֣ף בָּאֵ֔שׁ וַיִּטְחַ֖ן עַ֣ד אֲשֶׁר־ דָּ֑ק וַיִּ֙זֶר֙ עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י הַמַּ֔יִם בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ וַיַּ֖שְׁקְ אֶת־
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- hā·‘ê·ḡel ’ă·šer ‘ā·śū way·yiś·rōp̄ bā·’êš way·yiṭ·ḥan ‘aḏ ’ă·šer- dāq way·yi·zer ‘al- pə·nê ham·ma·yim bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·yašq ’eṯ-
verses.literal: Then he took - the calf they had made burned it in the fire ground [it] to - powder and scattered [the powder] over the face of the water Then he forced the Israelites to drink it

verses.original: מֶֽה־ הַזֶּ֑ה הָעָ֣ם עָשָׂ֥ה לְךָ֖ מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶֽל־ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אַהֲרֹ֔ן כִּֽי־ הֵבֵ֥אתָ עָלָ֖יו גְדֹלָֽה׃ חֲטָאָ֥ה
verses.transliteration: meh- haz·zeh hā·‘ām ‘ā·śāh lə·ḵā mō·šeh ’el- way·yō·mer ’a·hă·rōn kî- hê·ḇê·ṯā ‘ā·lāw ḡə·ḏō·lāh ḥă·ṭā·’āh
verses.literal: What did this people do to you Moses . . . asked Aaron that you have led them into so great a sin

verses.original: אַל־ יִ֥חַר אַ֖ף אֲדֹנִ֑י אַהֲרֹ֔ן וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אַתָּה֙ יָדַ֣עְתָּ אֶת־ הָעָ֔ם כִּ֥י בְרָ֖ע הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- yi·ḥar ’ap̄ ’ă·ḏō·nî ’a·hă·rōn way·yō·mer ’at·tāh yā·ḏa‘·tā ’eṯ- hā·‘ām kî ḇə·rā‘ hū
verses.literal: Do not be enraged . . . my lord Aaron replied You yourself know - that the people . . . are intent on evil . . .

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמְרוּ לִ֔י עֲשֵׂה־ לָ֣נוּ אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֵלְכ֖וּ לְפָנֵ֑ינוּ כִּי־ זֶ֣ה׀ מֹשֶׁ֣ה הָאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֶֽעֱלָ֙נוּ֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לֹ֥א יָדַ֖עְנוּ מֶה־ הָ֥יָה לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū lî ‘ă·śêh- lā·nū ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·šer yê·lə·ḵū lə·p̄ā·nê·nū kî- zeh mō·šeh hā·’îš ’ă·šer he·‘ĕ·lā·nū mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim lō yā·ḏa‘·nū meh- hā·yāh lōw
verses.literal: They told me Make us gods who will go before us As for this Moses - who brought us up out of the land of Egypt we do not know what has happened to him

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֤ר לָהֶם֙ לְמִ֣י זָהָ֔ב הִתְפָּרָ֖קוּ וַיִּתְּנוּ־ לִ֑י וָאַשְׁלִכֵ֣הוּ בָאֵ֔שׁ וַיֵּצֵ֖א הַזֶּֽה׃ הָעֵ֥גֶל
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar lā·hem lə·mî zā·hāḇ hiṯ·pā·rā·qū way·yit·tə·nū- lî wā·’aš·li·ḵê·hū ḇā·’êš way·yê·ṣê haz·zeh hā·‘ê·ḡel
verses.literal: So I said to them Whoever has gold let him take it off and they gave it to me And when I threw it into the fire out came this calf

verses.original: מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־ וַיַּ֤רְא הָעָ֔ם פָרֻ֖עַ ה֑וּא כִּֽי־ כִּ֥י אַהֲרֹ֔ן פְרָעֹ֣ה לְשִׁמְצָ֖ה בְּקָמֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh ’eṯ- way·yar hā·‘ām p̄ā·ru·a‘ hū kî- kî ’a·hă·rōn p̄ə·rā·‘ōh lə·šim·ṣāh bə·qā·mê·hem
verses.literal: Moses - saw that the people were out of control . . . . . . for Aaron had let them run wild and become a laughingstock to their enemies

verses.original: מֹשֶׁה֙ וַיַּעֲמֹ֤ד בְּשַׁ֣עַר הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מִ֥י לַיהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑י כָּל־ בְּנֵ֥י לֵוִֽי׃ וַיֵּאָסְפ֥וּ אֵלָ֖יו
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh way·ya·‘ă·mōḏ bə·ša·‘ar ham·ma·ḥă·neh way·yō·mer mî Yah·weh ’ê·lāy kāl- bə·nê lê·wî way·yê·’ā·sə·p̄ū ’ê·lāw
verses.literal: So Moses stood at the entrance to the camp and said Whoever is for the LORD come to me And all the Levites . . . gathered around him

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָהֶ֗ם כֹּֽה־ יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אָמַ֤ר אִישׁ־ שִׂ֥ימוּ חַרְבּ֖וֹ עַל־ יְרֵכ֑וֹ עִבְר֨וּ וָשׁ֜וּבוּ בַּֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה מִשַּׁ֤עַר לָשַׁ֙עַר֙ אִֽישׁ־ אֶת־ וְהִרְג֧וּ אָחִ֛יו וְאִ֥ישׁ אֶת־ רֵעֵ֖הוּ וְאִ֥ישׁ אֶת־ קְרֹבֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lā·hem kōh- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ’ā·mar ’îš- śî·mū ḥar·bōw ‘al- yə·rê·ḵōw ‘iḇ·rū wā·šū·ḇū bam·ma·ḥă·neh miš·ša·‘ar lā·ša·‘ar ’îš- ’eṯ- wə·hir·ḡū ’ā·ḥîw wə·’îš ’eṯ- rê·‘ê·hū wə·’îš ’eṯ- qə·rō·ḇōw
verses.literal: He told them This is what the LORD the God of Israel says Each of you men is to fasten his sword to his side go back and forth . . . through the camp from gate to gate - - and slay his brother . . . - his friend . . . - and his neighbor

verses.original: בְנֵֽי־ לֵוִ֖י וַיַּֽעֲשׂ֥וּ מֹשֶׁ֑ה כִּדְבַ֣ר הַה֔וּא בַּיּ֣וֹם כִּשְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אַלְפֵ֖י אִֽישׁ׃ מִן־ הָעָם֙ וַיִּפֹּ֤ל
verses.transliteration: ḇə·nê- lê·wî way·ya·‘ă·śū mō·šeh kiḏ·ḇar ha·hū bay·yō·wm kiš·lō·šeṯ ’al·p̄ê ’îš min- hā·‘ām way·yip·pōl
verses.literal: The Levites . . . did as Moses commanded and that day about three thousand - of the people fell dead

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֗ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר הַיּוֹם֙ מִלְא֨וּ יֶדְכֶ֤ם לַֽיהוָ֔ה כִּ֛י אִ֥ישׁ בִּבְנ֖וֹ וּבְאָחִ֑יו וְלָתֵ֧ת בְּרָכָֽה׃ עֲלֵיכֶ֛ם הַיּ֖וֹם
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh way·yō·mer hay·yō·wm mil·’ū yeḏ·ḵem Yah·weh kî ’îš biḇ·nōw ū·ḇə·’ā·ḥîw wə·lā·ṯêṯ bə·rā·ḵāh ‘ă·lê·ḵem hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: Afterward, Moses said Today you have been ordained for service to the LORD since each man went against his son and his brother so [the LORD] has bestowed a blessing on you this day

verses.original: וַיְהִי֙ מִֽמָּחֳרָ֔ת מֹשֶׁה֙ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל־ הָעָ֔ם אַתֶּ֥ם חֲטָאתֶ֖ם גְדֹלָ֑ה חֲטָאָ֣ה וְעַתָּה֙ אֶֽעֱלֶ֣ה אֶל־ יְהוָ֔ה אוּלַ֥י אֲכַפְּרָ֖ה בְּעַ֥ד חַטַּאתְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî mim·mā·ḥo·rāṯ mō·šeh way·yō·mer ’el- hā·‘ām ’at·tem ḥă·ṭā·ṯem ḡə·ḏō·lāh ḥă·ṭā·’āh wə·‘at·tāh ’e·‘ĕ·leh ’el- Yah·weh ’ū·lay ’ă·ḵap·pə·rāh bə·‘aḏ ḥaṭ·ṭaṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: - The next day Moses said to the people You have committed a great sin Now I will go up to the LORD perhaps I can make atonement for your sin

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֛ה וַיָּ֧שָׁב אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה וַיֹּאמַ֑ר אָ֣נָּ֗א גְדֹלָ֔ה חֲטָאָ֣ה הַזֶּה֙ הָעָ֤ם חָטָ֞א וַיַּֽעֲשׂ֥וּ אֱלֹהֵ֥י זָהָֽב׃ לָהֶ֖ם
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh way·yā·šāḇ ’el- Yah·weh way·yō·mar ’ān·nā ḡə·ḏō·lāh ḥă·ṭā·’āh haz·zeh hā·‘ām ḥā·ṭā way·ya·‘ă·śū ’ĕ·lō·hê zā·hāḇ lā·hem
verses.literal: So Moses returned to the LORD and said Oh what a great sin these people have committed They have made gods of gold for themselves

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֖ה אִם־ תִּשָּׂ֣א חַטָּאתָ֑ם וְאִם־ אַ֕יִן נָ֔א מְחֵ֣נִי מִֽסִּפְרְךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּתָֽבְתָּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ’im- tiś·śā ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯām wə·’im- ’a·yin nā mə·ḥê·nî mis·sip̄·rə·ḵā ’ă·šer kā·ṯā·ḇə·tā
verses.literal: Yet now if You would only forgive their sin But if not please blot me out of the book that You have written

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה מִ֚י אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָֽטָא־ לִ֔י אֶמְחֶ֖נּוּ מִסִּפְרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’el- mō·šeh mî ’ă·šer ḥā·ṭā- lî ’em·ḥen·nū mis·sip̄·rî
verses.literal: The LORD replied to Moses Whoever - has sinned against Me I will blot out of My book

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֞ה לֵ֣ךְ׀ נְחֵ֣ה אֶת־ הָעָ֗ם אֶ֤ל אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבַּ֙רְתִּי֙ לָ֔ךְ הִנֵּ֥ה מַלְאָכִ֖י יֵלֵ֣ךְ לְפָנֶ֑יךָ וּבְי֣וֹם פָּקְדִ֔י וּפָקַדְתִּ֥י עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם חַטָּאתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh lêḵ nə·ḥêh ’eṯ- hā·‘ām ’el ’ă·šer- dib·bar·tî lāḵ hin·nêh mal·’ā·ḵî yê·lêḵ lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā ū·ḇə·yō·wm pā·qə·ḏî ū·p̄ā·qaḏ·tî ‘ă·lê·hem ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯām
verses.literal: Now go lead - the people to [the place] - I described - Behold My angel shall go before you But on the day I settle accounts I will punish them . . . for their sin

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ וַיִּגֹּ֥ף הָעָ֑ם עַ֚ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשׂ֣וּ אֶת־ הָעֵ֔גֶל אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַהֲרֹֽן׃ס עָשָׂ֖ה
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’eṯ- way·yig·gōp̄ hā·‘ām ‘al ’ă·šer ‘ā·śū ’eṯ- hā·‘ê·ḡel ’ă·šer ’a·hă·rōn ‘ā·śāh
verses.literal: And the LORD - sent a plague on the people because of what they had done - with the calf that Aaron had made
